key_reasoning.reason: Three components touched — new pure cron_stagger module, Cron trigger construction in cron.py, and SchedulerSettingsService's next-run display — across Service and scheduler/infrastructure layers, but the module is self-contained and consumed via a single function signature in both call sites.

Follows an established precedent in the repo (job_lock.datasource_lock_key's BLAKE2b hashing) rather than inventing a new technique; deterministic and reversible (pure function, no stored state), but it is a new stagger algorithm with several wildcard/edge-case branches (hourly wildcard, day-of-week normalization) with no prior exact implementation to copy.

6 files changed per diffstat: 3 modified (cron.py, scheduler_settings_service.py, test_cron.py) and 3 new (cron_stagger.py, test_cron_stagger.py, test_scheduler_settings_service_stagger.py) across 3 directories (triggers/, triggers/bindings/, service/settings/ and their test mirrors) — maps to the M band (4-6 files) by the diffstat-to-score mapping.
